features: Ability to charge 3 types of devices
Converted to a lightning or 30 pin connector
24k hard-gold plated contacts provide excellent protection against corrosion
description: 3 IN 1: Get the ability to charge 3 types of devices - iphone, android and old iphone models. A base micro USB connector can be converted to a lightning or 30 pin connector with the provided adaptors CHARGE & SYNC The cable can charge and sync data to and from your smart device simultaneously at a rapid speeds. HI SPEED Easily transfer your multimedia files from your smartphone to and from your computer at high speeds. USB 2.0 ensures high data synchronisation speed of up to 480 Mbps DURABLE Comes with a flexible jacket to avoid cable stress and conductor fractures. 24k hard-gold plated contacts provide excellent protection against corrosion. RELIABLE 24k gold plated connectors guarantee perfect signal transmission with a firm connection shielded with tinned copper braiding to prevent EM/RF interference for an error-free data transmission
